acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in most cities, including Daly City and San Mateo, a permit is typically required for a tub to shower conversion. This is because the project often involves altering plumbing lines, which falls under building codes and regulations. Obtaining a permit ensures that the work complies with local safety and construction standards. As your general contractor, City Dweller, LLC will assist in navigating the permitting process with the local authorities to ensure all work is compliant.
